threshold_note: Chosen on validation by Youden's J, frozen before the test set was scored once.

grade_scale.label: Mild
grade_scale.meaning: Microaneurysms only; usually monitored, not referred urgently.

grade_scale.label: Moderate
grade_scale.meaning: More than microaneurysms; referable — specialist assessment advised.

grade_scale.label: Proliferative
grade_scale.meaning: New vessels / vitreous haemorrhage; referable, urgent.

clinical_note: The clinically actionable output is the binary referral decision (grade ≥ 2), not the exact 5-way grade. Exact severity is advisory and intentionally not used to make the referral call.
